### No Confirmed Events Found

After reviewing the provided search results and cross-referencing with known small independent venues (e.g., Institute of Modern Art, Milani Gallery, The Triffid, Avid Reader, The Bearded Lady, HSBNE Hackerspace, Sonder Language Exchange) and community groups (e.g., Philosophy Cafe, Creative Mornings Brisbane, Board Game BBQ), no events with **confirmed dates, times, venues, direct URLs, costs, and organisers** matching 11–17 May 2026 at qualifying niche spots were identified.

- Aggregators like EventCartel, Songkick, and Queensland.com list major concerts (e.g., at Fortitude Music Hall, The Triffid), sports (NRL Magic Round at Suncorp Stadium), and unrelated festivals, but lack specifics for this week at small/indie sites or are outside the date range.
- Specific pages (e.g., galleries, bookshops) yielded no 2026 May events in results.
- Recurring community meetups (e.g., open mics at Archive Bar, language exchanges at The Burrow) have no confirmed listings for these dates.

For real-time checks closer to the dates, visit venue sites directly (e.g., avidreader.com.au/events, thetriffid.com.au/gigs, beardedlady.net.au).
